name: Meyerland Plaza
summary: Meyerland Plaza is one of Houston's most prominent shopping centers, featuring department stores, a gym, and diverse dining, electronics, beauty, and clothing retailers. This well-established community destination serves southwest Houston with a comprehensive mix of retail and lifestyle amenities.
demographics: Meyerland Plaza serves the affluent Meyerland neighborhood and surrounding southwest Houston communities, attracting middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes typically ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+. The trade area draws a diverse demographic mix including established families, young professionals, and retirees, with a significant representation of ages 35-65. The center's location in a well-established residential area creates a loyal customer base that values convenience and quality, with shopping patterns focused on regular grocery trips, dining, fitness activities, and specialty retail needs.
description: Meyerland Plaza stands as one of the most prominent shopping centers in the Houston area, serving the vibrant southwest Houston community for decades. Located at 420 Meyerland Plaza in the heart of the established Meyerland neighborhood, this expansive retail destination has become a cornerstone of daily life for local residents. The center offers an impressive mix of department stores, specialty retailers, dining options, electronics shops, beauty services, and clothing boutiques, creating a comprehensive shopping experience under one roof. With a full-service gym and diverse dining options, Meyerland Plaza has evolved beyond traditional retail to become a lifestyle destination where the community gathers for shopping, fitness, and social activities. Managed by FRP Ltd., the center maintains high standards of quality and tenant mix, ensuring it remains a premier shopping destination in Houston's competitive retail landscape.
